body.content: Exploring lattice perturbation: Starting from 4x4 grid (16 points) with minimum triangle area 1/16=0.0625. Removing 3 points creates holes. Can we perturb remaining 13 points to increase minimum area? The grid is rigid; removing points creates small triangles with neighbors. A 4x4 grid has 286 triangles, min area 1/16. With 13 points, maybe 1/20 or 1/24 is achievable. Need to compute exact optimal for 13 points.
body.possible_next_move: Simulate random perturbations of 4x4 grid missing 3 points to find local maxima of minimum triangle area.
body.why_keep_this: Documents initial exploration of grid perturbation approach for 13-point minimum triangle area maximization.
